description: Find duplicate rows in a CSV, group each set with the row numbers it appears on, and return a deduplicated file keeping the first occurrence. Choose this when a CSV has repeated rows and you need them collapsed and named: the report groups each duplicate set with its row numbers and the delivered file keeps one copy of each row. Do not choose this when duplicates must be judged on a specific key column rather than the whole trimmed row. Example requests: Remove duplicate rows from this CSV and tell me which were duplicates. | How many duplicates are in this CSV file? | Give me a deduplicated copy of this CSV.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

content.description: The customer's input.csv, as text. Supported: CSV, TSV or any delimiter-separated text. Maximum 1048576 bytes.
